svg.title: This is Neurodora.
svg.desc: Handwritten black English wordmark with a coral marker underline, on a transparent background.
svg.metadata: Letter paths derived from Neucha by Jovanny Lemonad, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Custom spacing, weight, letter angles and vector underline. Artwork size 1695 by 928; visible artwork remains within x114–1641 and y118–785.
